ἰμέσος.definition: Prep.,c.gen., between, Schwyzer664.17 ; also ib.25; prob. fr

ἰξυόθεν.definition: Adv. from the loins, Arat.144; prob. l. for in Opp.C.2.6

ἱππόθεν.definition: Adv., forth from the horse, of the heroes descending from the Trojan horse, Od.8.515, 11.531

ἰσαχῶς.definition: Adv., in the same number of ways, Arist.Metaph.1013a16, al.; ib.1054a14; in as many ways as, Id.EN1096a23

ἶφι.definition: Ep. Adv. by force or might, freq. in Hom., but only with four Verbs, Il.1.38, etc.; 1.151; 19.417, Od.18.156; Il.3.375; later Euph.90, etc.—Freq. in prop. names, e.g. etc
